text:
nina: hey team — onboarding snag. i never received the Okta activation email, so SSO sign-in loops. Google Drive access works. 1Password invite still 'pending'. trying to set up a passkey on my Mac but device trust page says 'No devices found'. first day blocker — who should I ping? @it-ops

it-ops: hey @nina — welcome! quick q: are you on company Mac or personal? can you try an incognito window and paste the URL you see when the loop happens? also check spam for an email from Okta or 'no-reply@redwood.com'.

nina: company Mac (M1, macOS 13). loop url looks like `https://okta.redwood.com/sso/saml/...` — page just reloads after entering email. spam checked. no okta email at all.

it-ops: ok thanks. i pushed a manual activation for nina@redwood.com and added you to `redwood-onboarding` group. try now incognito. if it still loops, run `profiles show` and look for 'DeviceTrust' profile (no need to paste).

michael: welcome @nina :tada: i'm michael (hiring manager). i'll ping ana from security to nudge 1Password. for now i gave you view access to the team drive.

ana: hi — (typo fix) sorry created an alternate name accidentally. ignore.

ana: (repost) Hi @nina — 1Password invite resend done. Look for an email from hello@1password.com. If you don't see it, DM me. For passkeys: System Settings > Passwords & Passkeys should show 'Redwood' after Okta enrolls. YubiKey is also an option if you prefer hardware.

device-enroll-bot: device-enroll-bot: temporary device bypass granted for nina@redwood.com for 24h (reason: onboarding).

nina: ok i see Okta flow now, enrolled Okta Verify and created a passkey. accepted 1Password invite. drive access confirmed. quick Q: will the passkey work with VPN too or only webSSO?

it-ops: passkey covers web SSO and apps that support WebAuthn. VPN uses device certs — we'll set that up once device manager sees your profile. ping @ana if you need VPN sooner.

michael: great. @nina glad that fixed it. LMK if anything else. enjoy the first day!

nina: thanks all :pray: — all set.
